title: Linear finite models for locally finite transitive graphs
exact_target: Are finite transitive models of a local neighborhood always available with diameter at most a constant times its radius?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 10000026 (AMR-099-0026). CC BY 4.0.
